task_completion.description: The Weasis medical viewer application is open and visible on the screen.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window, including its toolbar and workspace, is visible in the screenshot.

task_completion.description: A DICOM image (X-Ray Angiography) is loaded into the main viewing area.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A medical X-ray image is displayed in the central viewport of the Weasis application.

task_completion.description: The distance measurement tool is activated from the toolbar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The distance/ruler icon in the Weasis toolbar is highlighted or selected, or the cursor changes to a crosshair/measurement icon.

task_completion.description: A measurement line with numerical distance values is drawn across a structure in the image.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A line or graphic overlay is visible on the DICOM image, accompanied by a text label showing a distance (e.g., in mm or pixels).

task_completion.description: The export dialog is opened and configured to save as a JPEG to the specific path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog box is visible, with the file format set to JPEG and the destination path showing /home/ga/DICOM/exports/annotated_measurement.jpg.

task_completion.description: The agent completes the export process.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The export dialog closes, or a success notification appears, or the file manager shows the new file 'annotated_measurement.jpg' in the target directory.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to perform the measurement and export, rather than using terminal commands to move or rename files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks on toolbar icons, and interaction with the Weasis export menu rather than just terminal output.

integrity.description: The measurement is manually placed on a relevant structure, not just a random click.
integrity.visual_evidence: The measurement line endpoints align with visible anatomical or medical structures in the X-ray.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply find an existing file and claim it was the result.
integrity.visual_evidence: The export process is visible in the GUI, showing the file being named and saved during the session.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The exported file must be a JPEG located at /home/ga/DICOM/exports/annotated_measurement.jpg. The file size must be at least 10,240 bytes. The image used is a multi-frame X-Ray Angiography (0002.DCM or 0003.DCM). The verifier specifically checks for the JPEG magic bytes (ffd8ff) at the start of the file.
